_purpose:
Independently authored EXPECTED provenance digests (Gate 4N-I17, Defect 5).
The OBSERVED side reads infra/aws/live-resource-inventory.json and scripts/signalnest_identity.py. The EXPECTED side reads THIS file. Gate 4N-I16 read both sides from the inventory, so rewriting the inventory to attacker values left provenance reporting clean.
_why_digests_not_values: storing the literal values would put the real account id and live ARNs into version control. Digests give the same independence — a changed observed value produces a different digest — while keeping no identifier in the tracked tree. Phase C forbids tracking production anchor material; this satisfies both constraints.
_authority: transcribed once from the retained pre-branch capture and the single identity source, then TRACKED. Changing an expected digest is a reviewable diff.
_tier_note: GATE 4N-I18, SEC-1. `expected_digests` anchors the REAL values and is selected only under TIER_2_PROTECTED. `expected_digests_synthetic` anchors the tracked synthetic inventory and is selected under TIER_1_SYNTHETIC, so ordinary CI exercises the full comparison path end-to-end after the live inventory left the repository. Neither set is derived from the observed side; both are tracked and a change to either is a reviewable diff.
